scope: Replay both existing completed-choice service streams exactly, in synchronized elapsed minutes. Strictly earlier failures release five measurements; order by end and id, alternate fit and confirmation devices, never fit on a confirmation or service device.
primary_family: Source stage CatBoost tree as deployed. When a fit device finishes, refit the identical phase recipe on source fit and all currently released fitting units. Target per record is remaining minutes divided by that unit's known total lifetime. Source and target domains have equal total training weight; devices have equal weight within a domain. Multiply predicted remaining fraction by the fixed source lifetime scale. This isolates learning new weights from replacing the time scale.
native_family: Start at the original official B checkpoint. When a fit device finishes, continue the last candidate on exactly one original Adam epoch of 72 source rows plus 72 deterministic balanced-device samples from the available fitting devices. Preserve official normalization and optimizer. All policies within a family share the exact same candidates so only release decisions differ.
controls: For each family issue frozen start, always use most recent trained candidate, and independent confirmation. At each release compare latest candidate and currently deployed model by equal-device mean squared error over all available disjoint confirmation units. Strict improvement adopts, tie retains. Also compare frozen direct CatBoost, training median and source stage tree.
metrics: Record all pooled service RMSE/MAE in minutes, worst-unit RMSE, per-unit RMSE, training identities/counts, label and CPU cost, announcements and service prediction differences. Shared computations only reduce experimental duplication.
gate: Retain a learned mixed candidate for further validation only if it beats the frozen strong phase tree by >=1% on both sites and worst-unit RMSE rises by <=1% on both. Credit autonomy only if confirmed also beats always-mixed and the best fixed baseline by >=1% on both. Otherwise close this specific recipe and review the whole system. Current windows are development replay.
